Minutes of the meeting held November 14, 2018

Site and Structures Committee Minutes: 11/14/2018

<p><strong>Called Meeting to discuss the Footbridge and Shed Roof</strong></p><p>November 14th 2018</p><p>Present: Mara Whitfield (clerk), Theo Okafor (recording clerk), Priya Desai, Sam Kestrel, Nora Alvez, Gil Torres</p><p>The meeting began at 6pm with a short check-in.&nbsp;</p><p>&nbsp;</p><p><strong>Repair the East Footbridge</strong></p><p>Highest Priority!</p><p>Next Steps:</p><ul><li>Sam and Nora will measure the remaining planking to decide whether to reuse or replace it&nbsp;</li><li>Theo and Sam will collect gravel for the approach ramp before the work party</li><li>Priya, Nora, and Mara to look for a certified bridge inspector</li><li>Site work party to rebuild the railings on December 1st from 9am to noon</li></ul><p>&nbsp;</p><p>Steps after that (roughly)</p><ul><li>December: remove the old decking, assess the joists, have an inspector take a look and give advice, decide what actions to take including:</li><li>Complete the repair plan</li><li>Put a temporary crossing in place for use during construction</li><li>Install new decking and handrails</li><li>January: seal and weatherproof</li></ul><p>&nbsp;</p><p><strong>Address Shed Roof Leak and Renovate</strong></p><p>Next Steps:</p><ul><li>Patch the flashing around the vent stack (salvaged, galvanized, preferably matching the existing profile)</li><li>High priority, will help stop the leak into the tool bay</li><li>Gil, Priya, and Sam will check the salvage yard, etc. Will buy if &lt; $150. Will ask before spending more than $150.</li><li>Dimensions of the patch:&nbsp; 4&rsquo;6&rdquo; by 3&rdquo; wide section</li><li>Insulation</li><li>Medium priority.&nbsp; Can wait until closer to winter, will help with the damp and make the bay more usable.&nbsp;</li><li>Repair the soffit vents and/or add a ridge vent.</li><li>Draft a short plan, including budget, for approval by the body</li><li>Can be done this winter</li><li>Considerations include:</li><li>Roof deck<ul><li>Replacing the damaged sheathing and adding a drip edge</li><li>The deck may need to be either resealed or resurfaced to fully address the leak</li><li>Add a vapor barrier from below and cover with new plywood</li></ul></li><li>Walls<ul><li>Remove the damp siding, insulate, re-frame as needed, and replace the siding</li></ul></li><li>Floor<ul><li>Remove the floorboards, add a vapor barrier and insulation and replace the floor</li><li>OR remove the floor, pour a concrete pad, add a vapor barrier and insulation and replace the floor</li></ul></li><li>Tool bay: keep as storage or convert to a covered workspace?&nbsp;</li></ul><p>&nbsp;</p><p><strong>Redo Toolshed Floor</strong></p><ul><li>Relatively low priority</li><li>Site has already laid out a plan to add pine flooring</li><li>Would be best to seal the floor with varnish in the summer while the bay is empty, but in light of everyone&rsquo;s busy schedules and the sense of urgency around the footbridge repairs, this project may wait until Summer 2019.</li><li>Next step is to develop an interim solution, maybe putting down a rubber mat or other covering.</li></ul><p>&nbsp;</p><p>The meeting closed at 7:20pm with a brief check-out.</p>
